title: Gran Torino is a must watch for this generation.

commenti.body:
Man I can't tell if you use the word Mongolian to refer to Asians, if you think Hmong people are from Mongolia, or if you're writing this larping as Clint Eastwood's character.

Good movie though
Wouldn’t Mong people be from mongolia? lol
Is the name of the people or country spelled differently?

Hmongolian actors just have a different style, it goes back to the time of Ghmongous Khmong, the famous playwright who conquered the Chinese theatre scene right before filmmaking became popular. You should really rewatch the movie and try to appreciate the unique style of acting on display.
Not interested in foreign cinema especially chinese. They shouldn’t try to bring that type of acting to America. Keep that in their country.
At this point, its all the same
Clint Eastwood is both an artist and a true American. He probably had a good reason for incorporating it into his movie, just saying

It probably would’ve worked if it wasn’t meant to be realistic. The asian actors were like anime characters with exaggerated expressions but inwiuld argue that its because they’re not good actors. I can see godzilla minus one and understand that style of acting.

What an absolutely asinine take.  Foreign cinema was always ghettoized to arthouse theaters and now practically eliminated due to their lack of economic viability post-covid.  Are you fussing about foreign cinema on streaming platforms?  Well I guess you should write angry letters to the Criterion Channel, MUBI, Tubi, Pluto, Netflix and Prime to remove all foreign language films.  Good luck with that.  


If you really love American cinema so much there's a plethora of infinite sequels, prequels, reboots, reimaginings, etc. and movies based on known IPs with high Q scores.  A zillion marvel movies, Disney movies, Fast & Furious movies and so on. You get to see Garfield or that IF movie with a happy-ass Grimace from Macdonalds for some reason.  You can always stream the Emoji movie since that's apparently the apex of American cinema for you.


It's really sad that you seem unable to appreciate movies across the planet.  Your contention that foreign films are taking over American cinemas is silly.  The only foreign movie that broke the 100 million box office barrier was Crouching Tiger Hidden Dragon but that was 24 years ago, I don't think your fears of the foreign hordes taking over the multiplex is likely to happen ever for reasons I've voluminously expressed.


Are you one of those people who are frightened and afraid of subtitles?  I got over that shit in high school.  Even tiktok videos have captions these days, so if that's the case too bad for you.


I've been on a bender over the past 6 months watching lots of Japanese, Korean, and Argentinian movies and they are just wonderfully amazing.  There's some really cool shit.out there outside our borders, you're missing out. too bad too sad for you.  I guess you'd be the target audience for the Emoji movie or robots beating the shit out of each other anyways.
